scope: Synapse model features OpenBlade represents as observed only, and the mini-LED local dimming Clear on RZ09-0510 and RZ09-0509.
method: Read-only review of pinned Synapse product bundles. Offsets are UTF-8 byte offsets into the file with the listed SHA-256. No hardware was accessed.

features.observed: Each mw main declares hasAMDOverclock. The Custom-mode CPU package power limit is 45-95 W in 1 W steps (694 UI main @6945431, 709 UI chunk 2915 @88779).
features.notRepresented: RZ09-0482 (product 669) is series 9: its power-limit path drives the V22 curve optimizer instead of a package power limit, so OpenBlade lists no CPU power limit for it.
features.writePath: Synapse applies the value through the native RzAMDOverClock vendor DLL. Its command contract is unreviewed, so OpenBlade adds no write path.

models.uiRanges: Unknown: the product 671 UI bundle was not reviewed. OpenBlade reports the shared defaults and leaves the ranges unknown.
Unknown: the product 672 UI bundle was not reviewed. OpenBlade reports the shared defaults and leaves the ranges unknown.

observed.defaults: turboBoostShortPowerMax {isEnabled:true, value:160}, turboBoostPowerMax 120, turboBoostPowerTimeWindow 56 (695 mw main @153501 and @156549).

features.writePath: Synapse applies the values through the native RzIntelOverClock vendor DLL. Its command contract is unreviewed, so OpenBlade adds no write path.
features.notRepresented: Synapse's Intel core-voltage offset control is outside this review.

features.observed: rzDevice25LedMatrixBladeWattage setOverClockingMode (582 @928): Gaming mode reads getThermalFanInformation 0D/83 [12,13,131] and passes GPU data[1..2] and VRAM data[3..4] to native SetGPUValue. Balanced, Creator and Battery Saver send SetGPUValue(0,0). The parser is at 582 rzDevice25 @57272, 597 @62544 and 616 @60211; product 597 6737 calls setOverClockingMode at @1186807 and @1559626.
features.unpinned: The 597 (rzDevice25LedMatrixBladeWattage.5473a2df...) and 616 (rzDevice25LedMatrixBladeWattage.f57ee707...) Wattage modules were not downloaded or hashed; those two models rest on their pinned main, 6737 and rzDevice25 files.
features.writePath: SetGPUValue is a native vendor call with no reviewed contract, so OpenBlade adds no write path. Gaming mode in OpenBlade does not apply this overclock.

panelGate.decoder: data[0] bits: DDS 0x01, Mini_LED_Resolution 0x02, Illegal_Battery_Support 0x04 (695 rzDevice25 @64925, getter @65054; 696 rzDevice25 @66696). The mask enum is module 83379: 695 6737 @899404 (enum @900284), 696 6737 @887911 (enum @888791).
panelGate.uiGate: The toggle is shown only when miniLedResolution === Mini_LED_Supported (2): 695 UI @6936465, 696 UI @7201418.
panelGate.openBladeRule: Offer Clear only after a decoded one-byte 0D/8F reply sets 0x02 and no bit outside 0x07. The panel is read once per device; a successful reading is kept, and a failed read is remembered and leaves the control unoffered. Every Clear reads 0D/8F again.

features.powerModeControl: 07/8F [1,7,143] reads cpuBoost 0x01, maxFan 0x02, oneTimeOverride 0x04, localDimming 0x08 (695 @47686, 696 @47296). 07/0F [1,7,15] writes the whole byte (localDimmingEnable=8 @1911627).
clearSequence: Fresh 07/8F read through the shared decoder; refuse undefined bits and refuse while 0x01 or 0x02 is set.
Read 07/8F again and require an exact match.
A possible submission without a matching readback pauses experimental writes with a local dimming obligation; recovery reads 07/8F and keeps the pause if it cannot. The write is never replayed.
features.notRepresented: Turning local dimming on is outside the developer-guide rule.

features.observed: hasLocalDimming is declared. In the product 709 6737 policy, a hasLocalDimming laptop outside Series 10 reads the Windows HDR state (isHDRModeEnable, near @1201992) and enqueues ON_ENABLE_LOCAL_DIMMING with it, so the 0x08 bit follows Windows HDR. The same code is in the product 695 policy near @1219093 and @1258842, where Series 10 (RZ09-0510, RZ09-0509) is excluded. Product 736 declares hasLocalDimming:!0 (mw main @163692) and its 6737 has the same coupling (isHDRModeEnable @1201990, ON_ENABLE_LOCAL_DIMMING @1202173).
features.writePath: Because the bit follows Windows HDR, a Clear could be undone by Windows or fight Synapse. OpenBlade shows the feature and adds no write path.

outOfScope: HyperBoost and NVIDIA GPU clock offsets on RZ09-0529 and RZ09-0530.
